headline: Trump’s ‘Super Intelligence Force’ aims for AI safety without slowing innovation
instagramCaption:
The Washington Post reports on Trump’s proposed 'Super Intelligence Force.'

This initiative seeks to ensure AI safety while preventing a slowdown in technological innovation.
The strategy focuses on balancing regulatory oversight with continued development speed.
This approach highlights the administration's priority on maintaining competitive edge.
